notes: Date anchors from the audio: 546 = Tue 22 Sep 1992 (shofar 'Monday Sept 28 and Tuesday Sept 29'); 547 = week of Vayeira 5753 (1 Nov 1992), the first show that says it has moved from Tuesday to Sunday 6 pm; 548 = Sun 8 Nov 1992; 552 = Sun 13 Dec 1992 ('Shabbos night the 19th of December is the first night of Chanukah'); 553 = 1st day of Chanukah (20 Dec); 554 = Zos Chanukah (27 Dec); 555 = 10 Teves 5753 (3 Jan 1993). There is a gap of about 6 weeks between 546 and 547 (Tishrei). Candle time in 549 (4:13) points to 22 Nov, which means there was no show on 15 Nov; 550 and 551 are interpolated.
From 546 on, every show has Tehillim (chapter 20) for the Rebbe's refuah shleimah (after his stroke in 1992), which helps date the period.
Serials with no catalog titles (I named them from what is said on air): 'Reb Boruch and the Alter Rebbe's Blessing' (548 ch1, 549 ch2) and 'The King Saved by a Shabbos Candle' (552 ch1, 553 ch2).

Re-airs: the Reb Boruch story (548+549) is told complete in ep. 509 (f748313861); the Chortkov Rebbe / Meir Anshel Rothschild story (550) is also in ep. 231 (32e12e850b); the Asarah B'Teves talk and the Ani Maamin guest segment in 555 also appear in 507 (b8577c47e9), in file '5' (efb72976ab) and in the clips 2cdc2fb9fd / 213559b057. The '5' and '507' files look like the same recording (offset about 2.5 min), so '5' may be a mislabeled or truncated copy of 507.
555: the opening 'today is Asarah B'Teves' may be reused from 507, but the weekly sequence still fits 3 Jan 1993.
554 story: Naftali's Rebbe is named as 'Rabbi Sholom Dov...' (ASR unclear). He could be the Rebbe Rashab, so I left him untagged.
Visiting classes identified only by school and teacher (548, 549, 551, 552) were given minor_named, because the validator requires a flag whenever hidden.on_air_people is filled.
Mishlei and Koheles were cited under the 'neviim' work id because there is no Kesuvim id; consider adding one.
